page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. At the top a woodcut ornament band, then a title block set in capitals and italics, then a large woodcut initial B opening the running text. Page number at upper right. Signature at the foot centred below the text.

main_text.head: IOANNES QVINTINVS HAEDVVS, IVRIS DOCTOR, ET ORDINARIVS IN PARISIORVM Vniuersitate celeberrima professor, studiosis Ecclesiasticorum Canonum lectoribus & auditoribus,
main_text.p: BIsego πετοβύπρΘ', & Annis, & Ordine, Neutri conuenire putaui, quod superest vitæ (si modò quid superesse Deus annuit) alio transigere cursu, quàm qui rectà me deducat eò, quò Christi sacerdoté, qui tanto suo satagat respondere nomini, Sacra solummodo dantem, Sacráque docentem, toto nisu contendere necessum est. Apinas forenses, & Aulicas tricas (Spes, videlicet, magnas, & certamina diuitiarũ) scio grauitati & excellétiæ Presbyterorum non congruere: sed & vetari. Quibus & in Exoticis Ethnicorum disciplinis vitam córerere nefas. Aliud igitur reliqui nihil est, quàm nos exhortationi, lectioni, doctrinæ totos attendere. page.notes: The large initial reads "B" (Biseg... as printed, first word "Is ego" with Greek interpolated). Greek "πετοβύπρΘ" is a doubtful transcription of the printed Greek word. Ligatures and abbreviations kept as printed; "Presbyterorum" and "tricas" are read from a faint scan. The first word of the body is printed as "IS" with an initial woodcut B; the body text begins "Isego".
